subject: Reminder: Upcoming Team Meeting
body: Hello team members, Just a friendly reminder that our monthly team meeting is scheduled for this Friday at 10:00 AM. Please make sure to review the agenda beforehand and come prepared to discuss any updates or issues. If you have any topics you'd like to add to the agenda, please send them to me by the end of the day. Looking forward to our productive discussion. See you all on Friday! Best regards, [Your Name]
